# telnyx_email_dedicated_ips (Data Source)

Lists email dedicated ips, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_email_dedicated_ip`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_pool_id` (String)
- `filter_region` (String)
- `filter_status` (String) One of `active`, `provisioning`, `released`, `suspended`, `warming_up`.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `email_dedicated_ips` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--email_dedicated_ips))

<a id="nestedatt--email_dedicated_ips"></a>
### Nested Schema for `email_dedicated_ips`

Read-Only:

- `billing` (Attributes) Monthly recurring charge (MRC) state for the IP's current allocation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--email_dedicated_ips--billing))
- `created_at` (String)
- `dns_confirmed_at` (String) When the PTR hostname was forward-confirmed (PTR → hostname → A record → this IP). The IP carries mail only while this is set.
- `id` (String)
- `ip_address` (String) The allocated IPv4/IPv6 address.
- `ip_version` (String)
- `pool_id` (String)
- `provisioning` (Attributes) Read-only status of the Telnyx-managed PTR record. No customer action is required to complete it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--email_dedicated_ips--provisioning))
- `provisioning_status` (String) Same value as `provisioning.dns_status`.
- `ptr_hostname` (String) Telnyx-managed reverse DNS (PTR) hostname of the IP, in the form `mta-<a-b-c-d>.msgtelnyx.com`. Also used as the EHLO hostname when sending from the IP. Managed by Telnyx and cannot be changed through the API.
- `quarantine_until` (String) Set on release to 30 days after `released_at`. The address is not returned to stock before this time.
- `record_type` (String)
- `region` (String) Region label of the allocated IP (for example, `ewr-nj1`).
- `released_at` (String) When the IP was released. Null until release.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status. `provisioning`: purchased and billed, carries no mail until `start_warmup`. `warming_up`: warm-up ramp in progress. `active`: ramp complete. `suspended`: suspended by Telnyx; carries no mail and is still billed. `released`: returned to Telnyx; carries no mail.
- `suspension_reason` (String) Reason Telnyx recorded when suspending the IP. Null unless `status` is `suspended`.
- `updated_at` (String)
- `warmup` (Attributes) Warmup ramp state for a dedicated IP. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--email_dedicated_ips--warmup))

<a id="nestedatt--email_dedicated_ips--billing"></a>
### Nested Schema for `email_dedicated_ips.billing`

Read-Only:

- `charged` (Boolean) True when `status` is `active`, `stopping`, or `stop_failed`. An IP carries mail only after its charge has been created.
- `status` (String) `not_started`: no charge recorded for the current allocation. `pending`: the charge is queued. `in_progress`: the charge is being created. `active`: the MRC is active. `stopping`: release requested; the MRC stop is being processed. `stopped`: the MRC has stopped. `stop_failed`: the MRC stop failed and the charge remains. `failed`: the charge could not be created.


<a id="nestedatt--email_dedicated_ips--provisioning"></a>
### Nested Schema for `email_dedicated_ips.provisioning`

Read-Only:

- `checklist` (Attributes) Informational progress flags for the Telnyx-managed PTR. They do not gate `start_warmup`; use `dns_status` to check whether the IP can carry mail. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--email_dedicated_ips--provisioning--checklist))
- `dns_status` (String) `dns_confirmed`: the PTR is forward-confirmed and `dns_confirmed_at` is set. `pending_ptr`: the PTR record is not yet in place. `pending_dns`: the PTR record is waiting for forward confirmation. `dns_lost`: a previously confirmed PTR no longer confirms, or the PTR request was abandoned before it ever confirmed (`ptr_request_state` is `abandoned`); the IP carries no mail until DNS is confirmed. `not_applicable`: the IP is released or has no PTR record on file.
- `ptr_request_pr_url` (String) Reference to the Telnyx PTR change request, when one exists. Informational.
- `ptr_request_state` (String) State of the Telnyx PTR change: `pending`, `pr_open`, `merged`, `confirmed`, `failed`, or `abandoned`. Informational.

<a id="nestedatt--email_dedicated_ips--provisioning--checklist"></a>
### Nested Schema for `email_dedicated_ips.provisioning.checklist`

Read-Only:

- `forward_confirmed` (Boolean)
- `ptr_authored` (Boolean)
- `ptr_merged` (Boolean)
- `ptr_requested` (Boolean)



<a id="nestedatt--email_dedicated_ips--warmup"></a>
### Nested Schema for `email_dedicated_ips.warmup`

Read-Only:

- `daily_cap` (Number) Daily cap of the current ramp stage. Null until the scheduler arms the first stage, and cleared when the ramp completes, automatically or through `complete_warmup`. On an `active` IP this value is informational and can keep an earlier stage cap after a suspension is lifted; it does not limit sending.
- `paused` (Boolean) True while the ramp is paused.
- `paused_at` (String) When the ramp was paused. Null when not paused.
- `progress` (Number) Ramp progress (0-100): the share of the 28 send-day schedule completed. Only UTC days on which the IP sent mail count. Set to 100 when the ramp completes, automatically or through `complete_warmup`. On an `active` IP this value is informational and can keep an earlier value after a suspension is lifted.
- `started_at` (String) When `start_warmup` was called. Null before warm-up starts and after release.
- `today` (Attributes) Today's warmup allowance report card (current UTC day). Null outside the warmup window (before start_warmup, after release/suspension). `active` IPs report the ramp-complete allowance, except as described for `cap`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--email_dedicated_ips--warmup--today))

<a id="nestedatt--email_dedicated_ips--warmup--today"></a>
### Nested Schema for `email_dedicated_ips.warmup.today`

Read-Only:

- `cap` (Number) The day's allowance cap. Null when the ramp has not opened yet (day 0: the scheduler has not armed a stage cap) — distinct from a spent day, which reports the cap with remaining 0. `active` IPs report `100000000`, the ramp-complete cap; `complete_warmup` applies it to the current day immediately. A day's allowance created before the IP became `active` can keep its stored `cap` and `remaining` until the next first-attempt send refreshes them.
- `day` (String) The UTC day this snapshot describes (warmup caps reset at UTC midnight).
- `granted` (Number) First-attempt sends released from warmup hold so far today. Delivery retries never lease allowance and are not counted.
- `remaining` (Number) Headroom left today. A queued send held by the daily cap is explained by remaining == 0; null mirrors cap (ramp not open yet). On an `active` IP whose `cap` is below `100000000`, remaining == 0 is a stored allowance and does not block the next eligible first-attempt send.
